events.title: Echoes of Aethelgard Demo 1.0.2 Patch Notes
events.summary: 1.0.2 -Fixed a bug where some enemies would not fade when being defeated. -Removed the audio for both dangerous enemy variants and lowhealth due to being initially too intense and disruptive to gameplay.-Fixed an issue where going to the armory screen again would break the Main Menu button.

events.title: Echoes of Aethelgard Demo 1.0.1 Patch Notes
events.summary: 1.0.1 -Added leaderboard tracking to the demo. -Fixed a bug where the main menu button would not work in the armory screen and would require the player to close out of the game.-Adjusted ambience audio to be more tolerable.

events.title: ⚔️ A Glimpse into the Aethelgard: Upcoming Demo Announcement!
events.summary: Hello everyone! We’ve been working hard in the forge, and it’s finally time to share a piece of Echoes of Aethelgard with you. We are thrilled to announce that a free demo will be launching soon.Why a Demo First? We want you to get your hands on the core gameplay early. This demo features the first level and our unique Rotating Aura system.
